biotools.summary: ShinyÉPICo is a graphical pipeline to analyze Illumina DNA methylation arrays (450k or EPIC). It allows to calculate differentially methylated positions and differentially methylated regions in a user-friendly interface. Moreover, it includes several options to export the results and obtain files to perform downstream analysis.
